_comment: Copy to /config.json on the S3 and edit. NEVER commit config.json (it is gitignored). This node has no radio, so unlike openplc-hot-tub there is nothing here about WiFi, MQTT or time — those belong to the P4 and its C6, and a board carrying no credentials is one less thing to leak. Only two keys matter. setpoint_f is the thermostat target in Fahrenheit, clamped to 60-104 by main.py, and the firmware WRITES THIS BACK whenever the HMI changes it, so the value below is only a starting point and the file must stay writable. ntc_cal is the water sensor's calibration; the values here are NTC_BALBOA_M7_CAL from sensors.py, matching the 30k Balboa M7 probe already in this tub. r_fixed is the divider resistor fitted on the board and stays 10000 whatever probe is on the leads — only r0 and beta describe the probe itself. For a generic 10k probe use r0 10000, beta 3950. offset_f is a final trim in Fahrenheit, added after the maths — set it against a reference thermometer once the tub is at temperature, and leave the rest alone unless the probe is replaced. A missing or unparseable file is not fatal: main.py falls back to the defaults in spa_core and sensors, which is why a first boot with no config still runs the plant.
